tools.name: Wispbyte
tools.what: A free hosting service, primarily used for Minecraft servers and Discord bots.
tools.why: Running Nexus locally would be near impossible due to the pain of having a device online 24/7. A hosting server makes this process a lot easier.

tools.name: Github
tools.what: A cloud-based developer platform used to manage software code.
tools.why: Nexus needed a place it store it`s website, this website is currently hosted on a open source repository in Github.

tools.name: Claude
tools.what: A website with family of large language models and an AI assistant developed to help with writing, analysis, coding, research, and task automation.
tools.why: Due to the controversies of AI generated content, I decided not to go into this project with fully using AI. Myself isn`t the greatest coder due to how late I started practicing it, AI is NOT used for the entire project though I have used to assist with my poor skills of coding. I personally estimate the bot to be 15-25% AI generated the other part being from an actual human (Myself). The website is a bit more AI generated which I estimate about 30%-40% to be generated.

tools.name: Discord Developer Portal
tools.what: The central hub where developers create and manage bots, apps, and games built on Discord.
tools.why: I think this is quite obvious, Nexus is created though the developer portal and needs this tool to exist.

libraries.name: discord.py
libraries.what: Connects to Discord and builds commands, buttons and layouts.
libraries.why: Base and main library for the bot, the bot is written in this.

libraries.name: aiohttp
libraries.what: Async web requests and a small web server.
libraries.why: It runs the dashboard API and the application and report forms, and fetches the site’s JSON files.

libraries.name: matplotlib
libraries.why: It makes the stats graphs, and supplies the font the games use for images.

libraries.name: Pillow
libraries.why: It draws the game boards and pictures.

libraries.name: deep-translator
libraries.why: Needed to run the translate command.

libraries.name: asyncio
libraries.why: It keeps one slow task from holding up everyone else.

libraries.name: sqlite3
libraries.why: It stores cases, settings, tickets, giveaways and more; the database service used to store everything that isn`t in memory.

libraries.name: time
libraries.why: They time mutes, bans, cooldowns, reminders and the 30-day stats cleanup.

libraries.name: re
libraries.why: AutoMod uses it to spot links, invites and blocked words.

libraries.name: random
libraries.why: It picks giveaway winners and shuffles games.

libraries.name: io
libraries.why: Charts and images are sent to Discord without temporary files.

libraries.name: json
libraries.why: It loads the website’s question files and handles form data.

libraries.name: hashlib, hmac, secrets
libraries.what: Hashing, safe comparison and random values.

libraries.name: ipaddress
libraries.why: The dashboard uses it for rate limiting.

libraries.name: threading
libraries.what: Runs a task on the side.
libraries.why: It reads console input for the data wipe tool without pausing the bot.

libraries.name: urllib.parse
libraries.why: AutoMod reads link domains with it, and the dashboard uses it for URLs.

libraries.name: collections, dataclasses, typing, contextlib
libraries.why: AutoMod tracks spam and raids with collections, and games count choices with it.

libraries.name: os, sys, math, traceback
libraries.what: System details, maths and error reports.
libraries.why: os reads dashboard settings, sys controls console output, math rounds sizes when drawing, and traceback prints errors.
